purpose: This table is the cleaned lookup of airline carriers that flew from New York City in 2013, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal name, sourced from the Bureau of Transportation Statistics via the nycflights13 package, feeding downstream joins from flight records to human-readable carrier names.
usage: Join on carrier to enrich flight-level records with the carrier's full name; carrier is the declared grain and unique business key, with 16 distinct codes covering all rows and no nulls in either column.
limitations: The dataset is static and tiny (16 rows, duplicate_row_rate 0.0), covering only carriers active in the 2013 NYC flights snapshot; three Airbyte capture-metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as they carried no business content.
